header.title: Easing
header.description: Motion acceleration curves: the `easing` object and the `--gemfx-easing-*` variables.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Five curves. Every dot travels the same distance in 1400 ms; only how it speeds up and slows down changes.
scale.reducedMotion: With reduced motion turned on, the dots stay still.

usage.standard: General movement that starts and ends on screen.
usage.enter: Elements that appear: they start fast and settle gently.
usage.exit: Elements that leave: they start gently and speed up on the way out.
usage.emphasized: Changes that need to stand out, such as panels or large transforms.
usage.linear: Continuous loops (marquees, rotations) and properties that should not accelerate.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: In CSS, use the variables (they ship in `tokens.css`, already included in `styles.css`). In TypeScript, `easing` returns strings that work in CSS and in the Web Animations API.
